limitations: The100-entry corpus is a citation-derived proxy, not measured global agent page visits; historical results are not rewritten.

Source-only outcomes remain extracted-unverified/contentSuccess:null, even when ordinary Markdown is empty.
Unsupported optional chart-type/modifier/axis qualifiers may be omitted with truncated:true; do not infer absent units or scaling.

Actual SafeJS SDK, credential/password/passkey/device, rendered interaction, TTY and access-handoff gates remain independent and open.
No credentials, redirects, retries, alternate browser, fingerprint changes, challenge solving or viewer/tracker requests in this live check.
Immutable source metadata is document-scoped, not clipped to an extraction selection; offsets are LF-normalized UTF16 script tag positions.
